hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook for Euler Finance that replaces Uniswap v4 pool pricing with a bespoke bonding curve. In beforeSwap, it computes input/output amounts via its own curve math, deposits input tokens into an Euler vault, withdraws output tokens from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta to the PoolManager — bypassing standard Uniswap liquidity entirely.
